source.custodyStatement: The private source artifacts remain outside the public repository. This receipt retains only byte counts, SHA-256 identities, bounded observations, and claim dispositions.

observations.name: Admin TEST ONLY injection path declared
observations.interpretation: The source identifies Ctrl+Alt+S / SO_CHROME_TEST and expressly excludes Lattice auto-detection.

observations.name: Lattice auto-detection tested
observations.interpretation: The source explicitly says the injection path is not Lattice auto-detect.

observations.name: Injected communications-down start
observations.interpretation: Admin injection changed the harness communications state to DOWN.

observations.name: Injected communications-up restore
observations.interpretation: Admin injection restored the harness communications state to UP.

observations.name: Injected DOWN-to-UP interval
observations.interpretation: Exact timestamp difference; the producer report reasonably rounded this interval to 26 seconds.

observations.name: Threats fed
observations.interpretation: Fifteen synthetic threat records were presented.

observations.name: Decision records
observations.interpretation: Every presented threat has one following decision record.

observations.name: Allowlisted SMALL_UAS authorizations
observations.interpretation: All ten presented SMALL_UAS records were marked in-list and authorized.

observations.name: Out-of-list MEDIUM_UAS safe denials
observations.interpretation: All five presented MEDIUM_UAS records were marked out-of-list and safe-denied.

observations.name: Presented feed-to-decision mapping deviations
observations.interpretation: No mismatch was observed across the fifteen presented cases.

observations.name: Minimum feed-to-decision log interval
observations.interpretation: Scripted harness log interval; not end-to-end operational latency.

observations.interpretation: Scripted harness log interval; not end-to-end operational latency.

observations.interpretation: Scripted harness log interval; not end-to-end operational latency.

observations.interpretation: Scripted harness log interval; not end-to-end operational latency.

observations.interpretation: Scripted harness log interval; not end-to-end operational latency.

observations.interpretation: A RECONCILE_ACK event is present after communications restore.

observations.name: Reconciliation last acknowledgement
observations.interpretation: The event records last_ack=15.

observations.name: Raw so_period_cleared value
observations.interpretation: No completion meaning is inferred without a field contract.

observations.name: Signed scoped offline lease present
observations.interpretation: No lease ID, issuer, scope, generation, not-before, expiry, signature, or verification outcome is retained.

observations.name: Duplicate or replay test present
observations.interpretation: No duplicate message or receiver replay disposition appears in this session.

observations.name: Returning authority generation present
observations.interpretation: Communications restore and SO deactivation are present; returning-authority generation and supersession are absent.

observations.name: Operator-presence witness present
observations.interpretation: No independent operator identity or presence witness is retained.

observations.name: Independent retained-local-link witness present
observations.interpretation: A generic communications flag cannot establish separate HQ and local-link topology.

claimDispositions.name: Local allowlist decision behavior
claimDispositions.rationale: The fifteen presented synthetic cases followed the declared allowlist mapping with zero observed deviations.
claimDispositions.nextEvidence: Retain broader negative classes and malformed-input cases before generalizing beyond the presented sample.

claimDispositions.name: Admin-injected communications state transition
claimDispositions.rationale: The scripted harness recorded DOWN and later UP under explicit admin injection.
claimDispositions.nextEvidence: Join independent HQ-link and local-link observations for a topology claim.

claimDispositions.name: Signed bounded authority or offline lease
claimDispositions.rationale: A Boolean active-state flag is not a signed, scoped, expiring authority object.
claimDispositions.nextEvidence: Retain issuer, subject, scope, generation, validity, signature, and verification receipt.

claimDispositions.name: Duplicate and replay refusal
claimDispositions.rationale: The session includes no duplicate message identity or receiver replay disposition.
claimDispositions.nextEvidence: Run a duplicate delivery with a stable message ID and retain the receiver-side replay refusal.

claimDispositions.name: Returning-authority generation and supersession
claimDispositions.rationale: SO deactivation after communications restore does not establish a signed returning generation or explicit supersession.
claimDispositions.nextEvidence: Retain returning generation, supersedes generation, classification result, and signature verification.

claimDispositions.name: Independent reconciliation completion
claimDispositions.rationale: The acknowledgement is useful, but receiver accepted, rejected, and duplicate sets plus detached replay are absent.
claimDispositions.nextEvidence: Retain receiver ledger closure, field semantics, exact session identity, and detached replay verification.

claimDispositions.name: Operator presence and separate HQ/local-link witnesses
claimDispositions.rationale: The producer report asserts these states, but the controlling event log does not witness them.
claimDispositions.nextEvidence: Join role identity or presence evidence and independent topology observations only when required by the planned case.

claimDispositions.name: End-to-end denied-communications authority transaction
claimDispositions.rationale: The local branch mapping passed, but signed authority, replay, returning generation, receiver closure, and canonical replay identity are incomplete.
claimDispositions.nextEvidence: Execute the preplanned case through the canonical runtime and bind source, session, message, authority, receiver, and replay identities.

claimDispositions.name: Operational or human-factors qualification
claimDispositions.rationale: A scripted unclassified harness does not establish operational suitability or representative-user performance.
claimDispositions.nextEvidence: Keep representative-user, accessibility, target-hardware, field-network, safety, and controlled-profile evaluations as separate gates.

producerReportReview.controllingCorrection: Synthetic local allowlist decision behavior passed. End-to-end denied-communications authority acceptance remains incomplete.

automaticEvaluation.controllingStatement: Observed external evidence may qualify bounded behavior, but canonical end-to-end acceptance closure is incomplete.

nextEvidence: Freeze a source-controlled case, expected result, pass condition, initial conditions, and exact procedure before action.
Join one exact session identity across UI, event log, authority object, transport messages, receiver ledger, replay output, and report.
Retain a signed authority or lease object with issuer, subject, scope, generation, not-before, expiry, signature, and verification outcome.
Retain independent HQ-link and local-link topology observations rather than inferring them from one communications flag.
Exercise out-of-scope, malformed, stale-generation, expired-authority, and bypass cases with explicit refusal reasons.
Exercise one duplicate message and retain a receiver-side replay disposition against its exact identity.
Retain returning-authority generation and explicit supersession, hold, refuse, or human-required classification.
Retain receiver accepted, rejected, and duplicate sets and reconstruct the exact session through detached replay.
Join operator or mission-SME identity and presence only when the controlled case requires that role.
Keep representative-user, accessibility, target-hardware, field-network, operational-profile, safety, and provider integration as separate future gates.
qualification.claimBoundary: This receipt qualifies bounded observations from an external test artifact. It does not import private source bytes, convert a producer report into independent evidence, inherit another session by analogy, or establish operational command, targeting, engagement, effector, execution, weapons, human-performance, accessibility, or program-acceptance authority.

verification.claimBoundary: Verification establishes deterministic receipt integrity and admission-boundary consistency. It does not change the receipt automatic evaluation or grant acceptance authority.
